# Prasad Gade - Full Profile

> Data Scientist and Computer Engineer from Mumbai, India. B.Tech student at Sardar Patel Institute of Technology (CGPA 9.37/10). Builds data pipelines, ML models, dashboards, and interactive web applications. Published researcher and hackathon winner.

## About This Site

prasadgade.dev is Prasad's personal portfolio. It is a single-page React app hosted on GitHub Pages.

This site is not just a resume. It represents who Prasad is as a person. It has technical projects, but also hobbies, favorite movies, a 3D Minecraft skin, a paper physics playground, in-app keyboard shortcuts, and hidden easter eggs. The site is built for everyone - recruiters, friends, colleagues, and anyone curious.

Site features:
- 4 visual themes: dark, light, arcade dark, arcade light
- Auto-detects device theme preference
- No-scroll desktop layout (everything fits one screen)
- 3D Minecraft skin viewer (using skinview3d and Three.js)
- Paper playground: the screen turns into a crumpled paper with real physics
- Hidden easter eggs: Konami code and "hesoyam" trigger animations
- Keyboard shortcuts available across the app; press ? to open the shortcut guide
- Tab shortcuts: 1 to 9 and 0 switch the main tabs
- In interactive tabs, Arrow keys move through cards and their nested links/actions, Home/End jump to the first or last interactive item, and Enter opens the focused action
- In the movies modal, Left and Right switch between the Movies and Web Shows tabs
- Space makes the Minecraft skin jump when the viewer is focused
- T still cycles themes while the Start Here, movies, resume, or Minecraft modal is open
- "Start Here" modal for non-tech visitors explaining every section
- Resume opens in an in-app modal
- Responsive for mobile, tablet, and desktop-site-on-mobile
- Every modal closes on ESC key
- Custom domain: prasadgade.dev

## Projects

The public agent-facing layer intentionally exposes these 12 projects and no more:

### GraphShield - Real-Data Graph ML for Financial Fraud Detection
- Built a leakage-safe graph ML research pipeline on DGraphFin with 3.7M nodes, 4.3M edges, 17 node features, and official supervised splits of 857,899 train, 183,862 validation, and 183,840 test nodes
- Implemented and evaluated GraphShield, a dual-path spectral GNN with low-pass and high-pass graph filters, against GraphSAGE, logistic regression, XGBoost, and prior baselines under extreme fraud-class imbalance
- Ran 6-seed real-data ablations showing GraphShield reached 0.0415 AUC-PR and 0.7748 AUC-ROC; removing low-pass, high-pass, or graph structure reduced AUC-PR to 0.0215, 0.0274, and 0.0264, respectively
- Added paired-bootstrap testing with 300 resamples, held-out conformal calibration, temporal/OOD drift diagnostics, and research-contract tests
- Tech: Python, PyTorch, PyTorch Geometric, Scikit-learn, XGBoost, NumPy, Pandas, SciPy, DGraphFin, Graph Neural Networks, Spectral Graph Filters, Conformal Prediction, Bootstrap Testing, Pytest
- GitHub: https://github.com/prasad-gade05/GraphShield

### IPL Analytics Platform - Interactive Cricket Data Dashboard
- Engineered a 3-stage IPL data pipeline over 278,205 ball-by-ball records from 18 seasons, producing a feature parquet plus 18 aggregate parquet datasets for fast analytics
- Built a 15-page Streamlit app backed by 19 DuckDB views, including player, team, venue, matchup, phase, records, tournament, and match-level analysis for 1,169 IPL matches
- Implemented a deterministic semantic search engine that compiles supported cricket questions into whitelisted SQL, ships with 40 example prompts, and exposes assumptions plus generated SQL instead of guessing unsupported requests
- Added a schema-driven per-visual control system and expanded regression coverage to 52 pytest checks to keep interactive filters and statistics aligned across the analytics pages
- Tech: Python, Streamlit, DuckDB, Plotly, Pandas, NumPy, PyArrow, Apache Parquet, SQL, pytest
- Demo: https://analytics-ipl.streamlit.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/prasad-gade05/IPL_Analysis

### UPI Analytics Platform - Data Engineering & Analytics Dashboard
- Processed 9,026 JSON files from 3 sources across 788 districts and 42 months using a 4-stage medallion pipeline into a DuckDB star schema
- Quantified market duopoly via HHI, measured geographic inequality via Gini coefficients, and segmented adoption tiers with K-Means
- Forecasted UPI volumes using Prophet and ARIMA; delivered 68 visualizations across 11-tab Streamlit and Power BI dashboards, validated by 83 tests via GitHub Actions CI/CD
- Demo: https://upi-analytics.streamlit.app/
- GitHub: https://github.com/prasad-gade05/UPI_DS_Project

### Lex Simulacra - AI Legal Courtroom Simulator
- Built an 8-agent legal courtroom simulator using LangGraph with stateful multi-turn debate, exposed through a real-time Streamlit UI and FastAPI SSE
- Designed a RAG pipeline over 100K+ legal documents using BM25 re-ranking and ChromaDB vector indexing for citation-grounded responses
- Improved context relevance by 3.2x through query refinement, context compression, and hallucination checks
- GitHub: https://github.com/prasad-gade05/Law_Courtroom_Simulator

### Intrusion Detection - TII-SSRC-23 Analysis
- Benchmarked 6 ML/DL models on the 8.6M-sample TII-SSRC-23 dataset using a leakage-safe stratified train-test split
- Achieved 99.99% test accuracy, 99.99% precision, and 100.00% rounded recall with the best Decision Tree model, reducing missed attacks to 13 false negatives on a 1.29M-sample test set
- Handled extreme 1:6653 class imbalance with threshold tuning and SMOTE-based resampling
- GitHub: https://github.com/prasad-gade05/IDS_on_TII-SSRC-23

### KindHearts - Donation Platform
- 1st place at Tech Horizon National Hackathon (80+ teams)
- Reduced donation request processing time by 60% with a modular SPA, dedicated dashboards, and protected routing
- Boosted engagement by 45% via real-time request tracking, MetaMask-based crypto payments, and impact reporting
- GitHub: https://github.com/prasad-gade05/KindHearts-Multi-Role-Donation-Management-Platform

### Celestial Classifier - SDSS Dataset Analysis
- Achieved 99.07% accuracy (0.99 F1) classifying 10,000 celestial objects using 10 engineered features
- Improved Neural Network accuracy from 95.13% to 98.78% using Keras Tuner across 10 trials
- Benchmarked 4 classifiers (DT: 87.75%, KNN: 94%, NN: 99%, RF: 99.07%) via GridSearchCV with 5-fold CV and 960+ fits
- GitHub: https://github.com/prasad-gade05/Celestial-Object-Classifier-using-Solana-Digital-Sky-Survey-Dataset

### NutriSnap - AI Nutrition Tracker

- Dual input modes (image/manual) with local SQLite storage

## Blogs

Prasad writes a personal blog at prasadgade.dev. All written content is 100% human-written. Thumbnails are AI-generated.

Blog pipeline:
- Source: one subfolder per post under blog-posts/, with exactly one Markdown file and one PNG file
- Validation: npm run blogs:sync fails if a post folder has missing, extra, or mismatched files/frontmatter
- Outputs: static post pages, public/blogs/blogs.json, public/blogs/rss.xml, sitemap blog URLs, and the blog sections in llms.txt and llms-full.txt
- Caching: generated pages, thumbnails, and shared files are written only when their content changes; unchanged outputs are skipped and stale generated post folders/assets are pruned
- Build hook: npm run build runs npm run blogs:sync first through prebuild, so npm run deploy publishes regenerated blog output

- Blog listing: https://prasadgade.dev/?tab=blogs
- Blog metadata (JSON): https://prasadgade.dev/blogs/blogs.json
- RSS feed: https://prasadgade.dev/blogs/rss.xml
